title: AnomalyGuard and RejectedSignalRouter — spike guard, stuck-key, audition routing
description:
Implement Source/DSP/AnomalyGuard (cable spike, stuck-key, dropout) and Source/DSP/RejectedSignalRouter (r[n]=x[n]-y[n] audition) per CHUGGATE_SPEC §19 and §20.5.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §19.1 Cable Spike Guard, §19.2 Stuck-Key, §19.3 Dropout Handling
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md §20.5 Rejected-Signal Audition choices and state-triggered audition
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for audition.rejectedMode and audition.stateFilterMode if present
- Existing performance state enum / detector envelope types so guards consume control flags without owning the state machine

AnomalyGuard.h/.cpp (§19):
- Cable Spike Guard: detect impulses with extreme peak, insufficient body energy, and sub-minimum duration; when flagged, suppress false gate opening (return shouldSuppressOpen / isSpikeActive) — NOT a limiter; do not hard-clip audio.
- Stuck-Key Detection: when external key is constantly active while main path is silent/noise-like for a documented hold time, set isStuckKeyWarning(); warning-only (no auto mute of key unless a clear API flag documents optional block).
- Dropout Handling: if sidechain/key stream disappears (or valid flag goes false), hold current control state briefly, then recommend/allow crossfade to internal detection when fallback enabled; expose isDropoutActive() / shouldUseInternalFallback() with configurable hold time.
- prepare(sampleRate)/reset(); analyze at block or per-sample control rate using preallocated state; no audio-thread heap alloc.

RejectedSignalRouter.h/.cpp (§20.5):
- r[n] = x[n] - y[n] (and optional per-band x_b - y_b when band buffers provided).
- Modes: Off, AllRejected, FullBand, Weight, Voice, Hiss, HissCurtain, NoiseModel, DetectorKey (match ParameterIDs audition.rejectedMode where possible).
- State-triggered audition filter: Off / Hold / Sustain / Release / Closed — when active, pass rejected material only while current performance state matches; otherwise mute audition.
- process outputs audition buffer from dry x, wet y, optional per-band rejects, optional noise-model or key taps; when mode Off, leave main path alone and silence audition.
- prepare/reset; fixed buffers only after prepare.

Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (g.4). Do NOT write tests (g.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: AnomalyGuard Cable Spike Guard flags extreme peak / low-body / short impulses and can suppress false opens without limiting audio
AnomalyGuard Stuck-Key detection warns when external key stays active while main path is silent/noise-like
AnomalyGuard Dropout handling holds briefly then exposes internal-detection fallback when sidechain disappears
RejectedSignalRouter computes r[n] = x[n] - y[n] and supports Armored audition modes including per-band and state-triggered filters
No heap allocation in the per-block process path after prepare for either unit
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified
forbidden_changes: implement a peak limiter as Cable Spike Guard

allowed: use documented peak/body/duration thresholds for spike classification
implement state filter by muting audition when state does not match
accept optional band/noise/key buffer pointers that may be null
forbidden: turn Cable Spike Guard into a sample peak limiter
